title: Control options for the `est=
text: Parallelism two axes.  unix, CHAINS run forked processes (`chainCores`, inheriting [rxode2::getRxThreads()] budget capped `chains`) serial evaluation inside chain. Windows, `chainCores > 1` runs one chain per PSOCK worker (worker builds linked likelihood); `cores` remains subject-parallel setting per worker.  `chainCores = 1` chains run sequentially likelihood evaluation subject-parallel instead (`cores`, defaulting `getRxThreads()`).  `getRxThreads()` honors `OMP_THREAD_LIMIT`, CRAN sets 2, checks stay within CRAN's core policy automatically. ODE-retry machinery (`maxOdeRecalc`, `stickyRecalcN`) stays nlmixr2est's defaults ENABLED: hard point retries relaxed tolerances instead rejecting, beats truncating posterior `-Inf` density actually finite.  safe sampler C batch entries reset retry/sticky/tolerance state top every evaluation (per batch per subject), point reproduces retry ladder value – density stays pure function state, gate G2 proves bitwise, retry machinery live.

title: nlmixr2bayes 0.0.1
text: First release. Adds Stan-based Bayesian estimation method ‘nlmixr2’ two independent subsystems. Likelihood-level linking (est = "stan", algorithm-named "nuts", "advi" "pathfinder" variants): Stan linked directly compiled ‘rxode2’/‘nlmixr2est’ likelihood instead model re-expressed Stan language. ODE solving, residual-error models censoring stay ‘rxode2’/‘nlmixr2est’; Stan receives log-likelihood analytic gradients precomputed_gradients() samples theta, Omega eta jointly. Prior distributions read model’s ini({}) block. Hand-coded Stan models (“rxstan” bridge, rxsRegister() / rxsStanModel() / rxsStanFromUi()): write .stan program declare ‘rxode2’ ODE solver backend via rx_solve(), models needing Stan code automatic path generate. paths support dosing events (bolus, infusion, addl, steady state), derivatives respect modeled lag time, bioavailability, duration rate, delay differential equations via delay() / past(), analytic parameter sensitivities forward sensitivity equations rather autodiff solver. Fits carry $stanfit, $stanCode $posteriorSummary, WAIC / LOO available ‘loo’ package. prior Stan samples can written ini({}) – dnorm(), dcauchy(), dbeta(), dgamma(), dlnorm(), dexp(), dunif(), dweibull(), dlogis(), studentT(), … – part posterior. ofv = "focei" (default) fit also reports FOCEi objective row posterior point estimate; row plug-likelihood criterion, comparable across nlmixr2 methods, evaluated without ini({}) priors. fit priors says $runInfo.
